known_current_toolkit_gaps: Species dependencies are now surfaced for LSB zone templates, but cross-lineage species/family equivalence is not yet proven generically.
Zone text/title enum references are not currently guaranteed to become package dependencies.
Cross-zone/system-state dependencies such as Besieged are not yet modeled as conditional semantic dependencies independent of direct code references.
Current LSB Besieged mob lifecycle hooks are present but empty, so source-code traversal alone cannot prove Medusa retail/system behavior.
closed_toolkit_gaps: mob_skill_lists membership is now a first-class logical schema surface.
mob_skills definitions are now first-class logical records.
mob_spell_lists membership is now a first-class logical schema surface.
Literal Lua require()/mixin dependencies are emitted as packageable REQUIRES artifact edges.
Statically resolvable ID.mob anchor arithmetic/ranges now resolve through IDs.lua GetFirstID plus zone mobs.yaml entity data.
Modern LSB zone mobs.yaml entities/templates now normalize into graph Entity nodes with entity->template dependencies.
Template species, mob skill-list, and mob spell-list dependencies now become transitive graph edges.
Mob skill-list members and mob spell-list members now close into normalized skill/spell definition nodes.
Mob skill definitions now link to conventional scripts/actions/mobskills/<name>.lua artifacts when those implementations exist; missing scripts remain explicit findings.
Zone YAML loot item symbols now resolve uniquely through normalized LSB item_basic names into canonical ITEM dependency nodes.
